reviews.text: I love snail everything so I had to try this serum! I particularly like how fast it sinks into the skin leaving it moisturize and ready for the next step of my routine. I'm kinda tired of tacky feeling most snail serums I've tried in the past have. It's also gentle enough for my sensitive skin. I will repurchase
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意所有蝸牛產品，所以一定要試吓呢款精華！我特別鍾意佢吸收得好快，令皮膚保持滋潤，可以即刻做下一步護膚。我有啲厭倦咗以前試過嘅大部分蝸牛精華嗰種黏膩感。佢亦都夠溫和，啱我嘅敏感皮膚。我會再買。

reviews.text: This serum has the same fresh subtle botanical fragance than the same line, and it's so subtle that won't annoy delicate noses. It's sort of watery, not sticky, and absorbs really really quick, quicker than other serums I used. I find quite sensorial and it's for me maybe one of the best I have ever used. Calming and soothing because of cica, artemisia, adenosine, camelia sinensis, salvia, and erases blemishes thanks to snail mucin, niacinamide, licorice, propolis. As you see it's packed with good ingredients.
reviews.zh: 呢款精華嘅香味同同系列其他產品一樣，係清新、淡淡嘅植物香，淡到唔會刺激敏感嘅鼻子。佢有啲似水，唔黏，吸收得非常快，比我用過嘅其他精華都快。我覺得佢好有感官享受，對我嚟講可能係我用過最好嘅一款之一。因為有積雪草、艾草、腺苷、茶葉同鼠尾草，所以有鎮靜同舒緩嘅效果；又因為有蝸牛黏液、菸酰胺、甘草同蜂膠，所以可以淡化瑕疵。你可以睇到，佢包含咗好多好嘅成分。

reviews.text: So handling my acne scars has never been easy, o really started to give up on having clear skin...thank goodness for the other reviews, I ended up purchasing this serum. Believe me when I say IT IS AMAZING!! be consistent morning and night application, and you will see results, I'm finally getting more comfortable with my bare skin and am I so happy. BUY IT you will not be disappointed, light weight and fast absorbing and not slimy.
reviews.zh: 要處理我嘅痘印一直都唔容易，我都開始放棄想要皮膚清透……幸好有其他評論，我最後買咗呢款精華。相信我，佢真係超正！！早晚都堅持用，你會見到效果。我終於對自己冇化妝嘅皮膚感到更自在，我好開心。買啦，你唔會失望嘅，質地輕盈、吸收快，唔會有黏黏滑滑嘅感覺。

reviews.text: just included some by mi’s snail truecica serum into my daily skin regimen and have noticed a positive difference in the clarity of my skin. I love the gel texture of the serum and only need two pumps to cover my facial skin and neck area. highly recommended, especially if you live in hot and humid climates...does not suffocate your pores...!!!
reviews.zh: 啱啱將 Some By Mi 嘅蝸牛 Truecica 精華加入咗我每日嘅護膚流程，我發覺我皮膚嘅清透度有正面嘅改變。我好鍾意呢款精華嘅啫喱質地，而且只需要壓兩下就可以覆蓋我嘅面同頸。非常推薦，特別係如果你住喺炎熱潮濕嘅地方……唔會悶住毛孔……！！！

reviews.text: Wow! I definitely recommend! After ONE use of this serum, my skin is so much clearer and softer. Some of my Acne scars have gone too after a week or so! I also have VERY dry skin but after using this, my dry skin is completely gone. Contrary to some other reviews, the smell is not an issue whatsoever. It has a subtle herbal(?) smell which is common in East Asian skincare and I actually enjoy it a lot. it smells very relaxing and gives the product more authenticity than what you would find in American skincare where it all smells like Bath and Body shops hahah. I am extremely impressed with the results I’ve achieved by using this product and I will definitely be purchasing again.
reviews.zh: 哇！我絕對推薦！只係用咗呢款精華一次，我嘅皮膚已經清透咗好多、亦都軟熟咗好多。大約一個星期之後，我嘅部分痘印都消失咗！我嘅皮膚都好乾，但用咗呢款之後，乾燥問題完全冇咗。同一啲其他評論相反，香味完全唔成問題。佢有少少草本（？）香味，呢種香味喺東亞護膚品好常見，我其實好鍾意。聞落好放鬆，比起美國護膚品——全部都好似 Bath and Body 店嘅味道——我覺得呢款產品更有正宗感。我好驚訝用呢款產品取得嘅效果，我一定會再買。

reviews.text: my very first Some By Mi product.. Its been my everyday skincare at the moment and im really loving it. it absorbs really well and it doesn’t feel sticky like other snail skincare products. i think im gonna keep using this and see how its been helping my skin! i only had it for few weeks so no noticeable changes yet.. definitely recommended though
reviews.zh: 我第一次用 Some By Mi 嘅產品。而家佢係我每日嘅護膚品，我真係好鍾意。吸收得好好，唔似其他蝸牛護膚品咁黏。我諗我會繼續用，睇吓佢點樣幫到我嘅皮膚！我只係用咗幾個星期，所以仲未見到明顯改變……不過絕對推薦。
